title: Meat & Dairy Watch
focus: meat and dairy industry lobbying, subsidies, policy, science
highlights: DBV lists 26 legislative initiatives in Bundestag lobby register, opposing Animal Welfare Act reform and stricter emissions rules (R002175)
State livestock-labelling in force 10.02.2026, full rollout delayed to 01.01.2027, four tiers become five
EU CAP: ~6.2bn EUR/year to Germany; meat+milk got >10x the fruit/veg direct payments; 15% of payments to 0.6% of farms
UBA: agriculture 60.8 Mt CO2e in 2025 (9.4% of DE total); cattle/pig methane + manure dominate
Copa-Cogeca EU lobbying 700-800k EUR (2024), EDA 100-200k EUR; German vet antibiotic sales rose to 562 t in 2024
actions_taken: web research: Bundestag lobby register, EU transparency register, GAP subsidies, UBA emissions, veterinary antibiotics
open PR against main (human review only; not merged)
guardrail: read-only watchdog: commits and opens PR only; never merges, force-pushes, or deletes branches
